content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

The architecture behind selling beats online without relying on Stripe or PayPal is built on sovereignty. It empowers creators to control their own e-commerce infrastructure, leveraging tools that are accessible and low-cost. Understanding this architecture is crucial because it eliminates dependency on commercial platforms that often charge high fees and restrict access based on location. By utilizing services like NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can retain a larger share of their earnings, ensuring their hard work translates into real income.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this architecture is a stack of free and open-source tools that work together seamlessly. For instance, a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing creates a resilient system. This allows creators to automate product delivery and manage orders efficiently. Each component interacts to ensure that when a customer makes a purchase, they receive their digital product automatically, while the creator retains complete control over their data and infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are inaccessible or financially burdensome. It caters to musicians, educators, and designers who sell beats, ebooks, templates, and more. By using a sovereign stack, creators can bypass the limitations imposed by conventional platforms, allowing them to reach their audience directly and effectively. This setup not only enhances their earning potential but also fosters a sense of ownership over their business infrastructure.
Sovereignty means you own your infrastructure, not rent it.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The essential components of this architecture include hosting services like GitHub Pages, backend solutions such as Google Apps Script, and payment processors like NOWPayments. GitHub Pages provides a reliable and cost-effective way to host your online store. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle the logic necessary for order management and automation. NOWPayments facilitates seamless crypto transactions, significantly reducing transaction fees compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on sales. Together, these components create a robust system that empowers creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by selecting the components that fit your needs. First, set up your hosting on GitHub Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage orders. Integrate NOWPayments to enable crypto transactions. Load your digital products and configure automated delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. For those who want a comprehensive solution, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the blueprints and templates needed to get started instantly.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign digital commerce stack. This involves using free hosting, backend automation tools, and crypto payment processors like NOWPayments, which have minimal fees and no account restrictions. This infrastructure allows for immediate product delivery and total data ownership.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, keeping more money in your pocket.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in exploring how to set up your own digital download store that exclusively accepts crypto payments, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes everything you need to deploy and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
